architecture.title: Ledger architecture
architecture.text: Requests flow inward through the layers; nothing in a lower layer imports an upper one.

items.text: Interface code never calls the store directly; it goes through a service.
Cross-cutting side effects (audit, email) are published on the event bus, not called inline.

meta.name: Service layer
meta.responsibility: Use cases such as posting entries and closing periods.

meta.name: Integration layer
meta.responsibility: Outbound side effects: the Event bus for audit events, email and bank feeds.

meta.provides: All SQL for entries, periods, tenants and reporting views; the only module that opens a database connection.

decisions.title: ADR 0003: Event bus for audit and email
decisions.text: Audit records and outbound email are produced by subscribers on the in-process Event bus.

meta.decision: Audit records and outbound email are produced by subscribers on the in-process Event bus, drained after commit.
alternatives: A message broker such as RabbitMQ
